scripts.build: npm run build:all && npm run test:ux:run && node tools/copy-ux-report.mjs
scripts.build:all: node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs build && node tools/fix-static-paths.mjs dist && node scripts/validate-rendered-lessons.mjs && node scripts/validate-course-visuals.mjs && node tools/generate-course-pdfs.mjs
scripts.check:content: npm run check:contract && python3 scripts/verify_lessons.py && python3 scripts/course_stats.py && npm run test:course-integrity
scripts.check:required: npm run check:content && npm run check:build && npm run check:e2e && npm run check:ux
scripts.check:full: npm run check:required && npm run check:lighthouse
scripts.test:course-integrity: python3 -m unittest scripts/test_course_integrity.py && node --test scripts/test_plantuml_diagnostics.mjs && python3 scripts/course_integrity.py --strict
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:build && node tools/copy-ux-report.mjs && node tools/run-playwright.mjs test --project=visual
scripts.test:ux: npm run test:build && npm run test:ux:run && node tools/copy-ux-report.mjs
scripts.test:lighthouse: npm run test:build && npm run test:lighthouse:run
